io_thread_pool_size.description: Number of Netty NIO event loop threads for network I/O. Default: Runtime.availableProcessors(). On high-CPU machines (e.g., 96 vCPUs), reducing this to 16-32 can significantly reduce scheduling contention.

computation_thread_pool_size.description: Number of computation/reactor threads for reactive operations and completions. Default: Runtime.availableProcessors().
